name: El Mercado
summary: Rafael Osterling's lively, lunch-only cevichería with a creative seafood menu and online booking. Expect a long lunch, pricier than a classic cevichería; some visitors find it a bit hyped.

value.text: About S/300-400 for two (~US$90-120) for a full lunch with drinks; S/55 average per plate

facts.value: Peruvian seafood / cevichería with Nikkei, chifa and Mediterranean touches

items.name: Ceviche Mercado
items.description: El Combinado: catch of the day in ají amarillo leche de tigre with calamari chicharrón.

items.name: Ceviche Neptuno
items.description: Robalo, prawns, scallops, grilled octopus, rich leche de tigre.

items.name: Tiradito Samurai
items.description: Tuna tataki, hondashi, pickled cucumber, avocado, caviar.

items.name: Tiradito Punta Hermosa
items.description: Silverside, scallops, sea urchin, avocado, ají mochero, tropical tigresa.

items.name: Conchas Reggiana
items.description: Grilled scallops, burnt-butter cream, parmesan, white wine, confit garlic.

items.name: Conchas del Griego
items.description: Scallops in bubbling pisco butter, ají amarillo, fresh oregano.

items.name: Pulpo a la parrilla
items.description: Smoky grilled octopus, parsley cream, potatoes, mushrooms.

items.name: Tuna Burger Bun
items.description: Charcoal tuna burger, miso mayo, pickles.

items.name: Socarrat
items.description: Bomba rice in concolón with octopus, scallops, prawns, clams, seafood broth.

items.name: Arroz verde piurano
items.description: Green rice with black clams, clams, prawns, loche, chicha de jora.

items.name: Chaufa Fusión
items.description: Suckling pig chicharrón, prawns, squid, clams, Shanghai-style fried plantain.

items.name: Churros del Mercado
items.description: Churros with bubbling chocolate dip, dulce de leche, vanilla ice cream.

facts.value: Not confirmed. A card is required to book online; whether a charge applies was not seen.

value.format: Daytime-only à la carte lunch, indoor-outdoor room with long bar and cocktails
cons: Pricey vs classic cevicherías; no published prices
accolades: Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2024: No. 93 (El Comercio)
value.how_to_book: Online booking for 1-6 guests; larger parties via WhatsApp/email. Researcher stopped at the time picker and entered no details. Weekend slots scarce.
